title: Test God and Watch What Happens When You Tithe
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he challenges you to step out in faith and trust God with your finances by practicing the biblical principle of tithing. Discover how giving to God can bring miraculous results and transform your life, and be encouraged by testimonies of how God has blessed families who have obeyed this command. Don't miss this powerful sermon, "Testing God: Trusting Him with Our Finances.
